summary: PowerBank Corp filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, attaching a press release confirming procurement agreements totaling $242.3 million USD for 23 distributed solar and energy storage projects in New York and Pennsylvania. The projects represent 97 MW DC of solar and 42 MWh of storage, with an estimated $94.7 million in federal Investment Tax Credits. The safe harbor was secured under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act via the Physical Work Test, with first 15 projects completed by December 31, 2025, and remaining 8 targeted before July 4, 2026. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
